title.narrative: Tanzania Renewable Energy CDM Program of Activities

description.narrative: The objective of the CDM-PoA project is to increase the capacity of renewable energies installed - including hydro, solar, wind and/or biomass technologies for electricity generation. The subprojects can be: isolated mini-grids, connected to the national grid or connected to one of the national utility’s isolated grids. Over the long term, this will lead to increased access to modern energy services in Tanzania.
